categories.label: Rotation
categories.blurb: Animates rotate. For when the roadmap goes in circles.

categories.label: Movement
categories.blurb: Animates translate. Moves things around, like your boss moves deadlines.

categories.label: Filters
categories.blurb: Animates filter. Colors your designer never approved.

categories.label: Opacity
categories.blurb: Animates opacity. Appears and disappears like the PM at retros.

categories.label: Special effects
categories.blurb: Use ::before and ::after. One per element; this isn't Hollywood.

categories.label: Utilities
categories.blurb: No animation. Classes that do weird things, but stand still.

categories.label: Modifiers
categories.blurb: Change how the other classes animate. Like Tailwind's hover:, but in hieroglyphics.

emojis.name: spin
emojis.desc: Spins forever. Like your on-call rotation on a Saturday.

emojis.name: ferris
emojis.desc: Slow, contemplative rotation. Perfect for 40-second loading screens.

emojis.name: flip
emojis.desc: Turns upside down, has second thoughts, comes back. Just like the last refactor.

emojis.name: dance
emojis.desc: Dances side to side. No rhythm, plenty of attitude.

emojis.name: ring
emojis.desc: Rings like a Slack notification at 11:58 PM.

emojis.name: wobble
emojis.desc: Friday after-work wobble. Not suitable for client demos.

emojis.name: compass
emojis.desc: Searches for north, like your product strategy. Doesn't find it either.

emojis.name: vortex
emojis.desc: Gets sucked into a whirlpool and comes back. Like your time in meetings.

emojis.name: boomerang
emojis.desc: Flies off spinning and comes right back. Like that bug you closed as "won't fix".

emojis.name: alarm
emojis.desc: Rattles in bursts. The sprint ends tomorrow.

emojis.name: bounce
emojis.desc: Bounces. The classic every framework ships and nobody needs.

emojis.name: float
emojis.desc: Floats gently. Like your Monday motivation, but upwards.

emojis.name: shake
emojis.desc: Trembles. Perfect for the "Drop production database" button.

emojis.name: jump
emojis.desc: Jumps, rests, jumps. Like someone who switches jobs every 11 months.

emojis.name: shiver
emojis.desc: Shivers. Someone set the office AC to 62 °F.

emojis.name: ufo
emojis.desc: Flies in a figure eight. Undocumented behavior, just like your API.

emojis.name: slither
emojis.desc: Slips from side to side. Like accountability in a post-mortem.

emojis.name: launch
emojis.desc: Takes off and comes back. Blazingly fast™, written in Rust (not really).

emojis.name: stonks
emojis.desc: Only goes up. Use it on the investor slide and nowhere else.

emojis.name: crash
emojis.desc: Plummets while spinning. Your crypto portfolio, now in CSS.

emojis.name: parachute
emojis.desc: Drops in from above, swaying. Like the new VP fresh out of consulting.

emojis.name: pingpong
emojis.desc: Back and forth. Like a ticket between backend and frontend.

emojis.name: magnet
emojis.desc: Gets pulled to the right and snaps back. Like you when there's pizza in the kitchen.

emojis.name: yoyo
emojis.desc: Drops fast, climbs slowly. A junior's self-esteem during code review.

emojis.name: heartbeat
emojis.desc: Beats. Makes your CTA convert 300% better (source: I made it up).

emojis.name: breathe
emojis.desc: Takes a deep breath. Use it on the "Deploy to production" button.

emojis.name: jelly
emojis.desc: Wobbles like jelly. Just like the microservices architecture you built in 2019.

emojis.name: pop
emojis.desc: Pops in with a bounce. Only once, because it gets old.

emojis.name: puff
emojis.desc: Puffs up and deflates. Like your ego after a founder likes your LinkedIn post.

emojis.name: shrink
emojis.desc: Shrinks. Like your training budget.

emojis.name: zoom
emojis.desc: Zooms in. For reviewing that 4,000-line PR "carefully".

emojis.name: melt
emojis.desc: Melts. You at the 9 AM standup after a late-night hotfix.

emojis.name: rainbow
emojis.desc: Cycles through every color. For when the brand guidelines are a "suggestion".

emojis.name: glow
emojis.desc: Glows with its own light. Unlike your idea in the brainstorm.

emojis.name: dizzy
emojis.desc: Blurs and refocuses. A 3-code-point ZWJ sequence as a CSS class, because we can.

emojis.name: flicker
emojis.desc: Flickers like the fluorescent tube in the server room.

emojis.name: invert
emojis.desc: Dark mode, implemented by an intern in 5 minutes.

emojis.name: radioactive
emojis.desc: Toxic green glow. Mark the module nobody dares to touch.

emojis.name: fog
emojis.desc: Fades in and out of the fog. Like the project requirements.

emojis.name: trip
emojis.desc: Experimental saturation. A feature flag enabled in production "just to test".

emojis.name: flash
emojis.desc: Camera flash. For the dashboard screenshot right when everything is green.

emojis.name: heat
emojis.desc: Overheats. Like your laptop running Slack, Teams, Chrome and Docker at once.

emojis.name: blink
emojis.desc: Brings back the <blink> tag. Rest in peace (1995–2013).

emojis.name: ghost
emojis.desc: Floats and turns see-through. Like the client after signing.

emojis.name: vanish
emojis.desc: Slowly disappears. Your camera during a two-hour meeting.

emojis.name: candle
emojis.desc: Flickers like a candle. Romantic ambience for your login screen.

emojis.name: glitch
emojis.desc: Glitch with chromatic aberration. Cyberpunk aesthetics, intern budget.

emojis.name: wave
emojis.desc: Waves like a flag. Or like your tolerance for scope changes.

emojis.name: spaghetti
emojis.desc: Twists with no apparent logic. A faithful portrait of your legacy code.

emojis.name: coin
emojis.desc: Spins in 3D like a coin. Heads: Kubernetes. Tails: also Kubernetes.

emojis.name: pancake
emojis.desc: Flips backwards like a pancake. Sunday brunch and deploys.

emojis.name: fire
emojis.desc: The text is on fire. Recommended for production error messages.

emojis.name: siren
emojis.desc: Police lights. For your favorite "P0 incident" badge.

emojis.name: disco
emojis.desc: Full-color disco glow. Your MVP launch party.

emojis.name: terminal
emojis.desc: Phosphor green with CRT glow. Either you're hacking the Pentagon or tweaking some CSS.

emojis.name: electric
emojis.desc: Electric discharges. "Deployed it without tests" vibes.

emojis.name: underline
emojis.desc: Draws a pencil underline. Like the college notes you never reread.

emojis.name: highlight
emojis.desc: Sweeps a highlighter. Ideal for the parts of the docs nobody will read.

emojis.name: unicorn
emojis.desc: Moving rainbow gradient text. Valuation: $1B. Revenue: $0.

emojis.name: shimmer
emojis.desc: A shine sweeps across the text. Makes anything look like a paid plan.

emojis.name: stripes
emojis.desc: Moving stripes. The 2004 progress bar that never reached 100%.

emojis.name: sparkles
emojis.desc: Sheds sparkles all around. For "AI-powered" features that are just an if.

emojis.name: confetti
emojis.desc: A burst of confetti. Celebrate the pipeline passing on the third try.

emojis.name: hearts
emojis.desc: Releases floating hearts. Artificial engagement, Instagram Live style.

emojis.name: money
emojis.desc: It's raining money. Exactly like the funding round of your dreams.

emojis.name: snow
emojis.desc: Snows inside the element. The holiday code freeze, visualized.

emojis.name: steam
emojis.desc: Lets off steam. Freshly baked code: no tests, but nice and warm.

emojis.name: typing
emojis.desc: Adds a blinking cursor. Makes it look like an AI wrote it (and maybe one did).

emojis.name: dealwithit
emojis.desc: Sunglasses drop on top. Deal with it. Only once, out of respect.

emojis.name: stamp
emojis.desc: Stamps a 💯 in the corner. Approved without reading, as tradition demands.

emojis.name: sleep
emojis.desc: Floats out Z's. For any meeting that could have been an email.

emojis.name: bubbles
emojis.desc: Bubbles rising. Just like AI startup valuations.

emojis.name: comic
emojis.desc: Comic Sans. The only typeface that takes this library as seriously as you do.

emojis.name: shout
emojis.desc: UPPERCASE AND BOLD. FOR COMMUNICATING LIKE IN #GENERAL.

emojis.name: spoiler
emojis.desc: Blurred until you hover. Sensitive information, Post-it-level security.

emojis.name: frozen
emojis.desc: Freezes every animation and gives it an icy tint. Official code freeze.

emojis.name: bug
emojis.desc: Shifts the element 1px to the right. Nobody will ever know why.

emojis.name: moai
emojis.desc: Does absolutely nothing. Enterprise stability. Zero regressions since day one.

emojis.name: reset
emojis.desc: Washes the element: removes every EmojiCSS animation. For when Legal shows up.

emojis.name: speed-x4
emojis.desc: Four times slower. The speed of an architecture committee.

emojis.name: speed-x2
emojis.desc: Twice as slow. Like your CI pipeline.

emojis.name: speed-half
emojis.desc: Twice as fast. Like a PM promising dates.

emojis.name: speed-quarter
emojis.desc: Four times faster. Helmet recommended.

emojis.name: once
emojis.desc: Plays once. Like your last raise.

emojis.name: thrice
emojis.desc: Three times, then stops. About as long as a good intention lasts.

emojis.name: infinite
emojis.desc: Repeats forever. Like the tabs vs. spaces debate.

emojis.name: reverse
emojis.desc: Plays backwards. Ctrl+Z as an animation.

emojis.name: alternate
emojis.desc: There and back again. Like the requirements.

emojis.name: delay
emojis.desc: Waits half a second before starting. Like the loader you added "so people notice".

emojis.name: delay-long
emojis.desc: Waits 1.5 seconds. To build anticipation (or patience).

emojis.name: paused
emojis.desc: Pauses the animation. Very useful for doing nothing in style.

emojis.name: hover
emojis.desc: Only animates on hover. Tailwind's hover: for people with self-control.
